title: Towards Reliable, Generalizable, and Specific In-Context Knowledge Editing via Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.25100v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are powerful but limited by static parametric knowledge that becomes outdated once pretraining ends. Knowledge editing addresses this problem by updating model behavior on target facts without full retraining. In particular, in-context knowledge editing has gained attention because it is training-free and readily applicable to black-box LLMs. Recent reinforcement learning (RL)-based approaches improve over fixed retrieval strategies by adapting prompt construction to the quantity-quality trade-off. Despite initial success, they fail to model the prompt as a structured entity under the distinct and often competing objectives of reliability, generality, and specificity. Previous methods largely optimize a single objective and make decisions over only part of the prompt construction process, thereby overlooking both the balance of different objectives and the global organization of demonstrations. translated_title: 基于多目标强化学习的可靠、泛化且特异性的上下文知识编辑方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25100v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大型语言模型（LLMs）功能强大，但受限于静态参数化知识，一旦预训练结束，这些知识就会过时。知识编辑通过更新模型对目标事实的行为来解决这一问题，而无需完全重新训练。特别是，上下文知识编辑因其无需训练且易于应用于黑盒LLMs而受到关注。最近的基于强化学习（RL）的方法通过适应提示构建中的数量-质量权衡，改进了固定的检索策略。尽管取得了初步成功，但这些方法未能将提示视为一个结构化实体，在可靠性、泛化性和特异性等不同且往往相互竞争的目标下进行建模。以往的方法大多优化单一目标，并且仅对提示构建过程的部分环节做出决策，从而忽视了不同目标之间的平衡以及演示的整体组织。我们提出了M方法来解决这些挑战。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于多目标强化学习的上下文知识编辑方法，通过结构化建模提示并平衡可靠性、泛化性和特异性目标，以提升知识编辑的整体性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-objective reinforcement learning-based in-context knowledge editing method that structurally models prompts and balances reliability, generality, and specificity objectives to improve overall editing performance.
